summary: Yimutian Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company, through its subsidiary Beijing Yimutian, entered two definitive agreements on August 20, 2026, to acquire Chinese assets via VIE structures. It agreed to purchase 100% equity of Qingdao Xingongguan Holiday Hotel Co., Ltd. for $5.8 million, paid as 9,963,353,184 Class A ordinary shares priced at $0.2183 per ADS (each ADS = 375 shares), based on five-day average ADS price. Separately, it agreed to acquire land, buildings, and equipment from Zhaodong Guohe Animal Husbandry for $21.16 million, payable in 36,351,449,375 shares. Both deals include six-month cleanup periods with share certificates withheld until conditions met, are PRC-governed with CIETAC arbitration, and involve customary reps/warranties. What to watch: completion of VIE agreements and asset cleanup before share delivery; risk-arb angle includes high dilution from share issuance and potential regulatory scrutiny.
